title: Resetting the Optimizer in Deep RL: An Empirical Study
mechanism: Несоответствие Adam moments новому objective после target sync.
intervention: Full, first-only и second-only moment resets.
diagnostic: Cosine gradient/first moment до и после target update.
limitations: Заданное расписание; partial-reset clock semantics и exact author patch не подтверждены; configs/target schedules отличаются в сравнениях.
relevance: Основа optimizer arms; положительный reset не идентифицирует единственную причину.

title: Adam on Local Time: Addressing Nonstationarity in RL with Relative Adam Timesteps
mechanism: Gradient-scale jumps вызывают нестабильные Adam updates.
intervention: Сброс t без сброса moments; сравнение с Adam-MR.
diagnostic: Gradient norm, update norm и maximum update.
limitations: Эффект также связан с LR schedule; headline PPO configs меняют LR/clipping/GAE; авторские anonymous code URLs expired на дату аудита.
relevance: Нужен t-only arm; полный reset может вредить.

title: Dissecting Deep RL with High Update Ratios: Combatting Value Divergence
mechanism: Unseen-action overestimation, Adam statistics, Q divergence.
intervention: Output Feature Normalization; priming optimizer ablations; reset comparisons.
diagnostic: Q scale, returns и effective feature dimension.
limitations: High-UTD SAC/priming; interventions затрагивают разные компоненты.
relevance: Показывает взаимодействие optimizer/targets/data; rank иногда восстанавливается.

title: Implicit Under-Parameterization Inhibits Data-Efficient Deep Reinforcement Learning
mechanism: Bootstrap regression и optimization могут снижать feature expressivity.
intervention: Spectral penalty на крайние singular values features.
limitations: Теоретические модели упрощены; rank не напрямую trainability.
relevance: Классический источник rank diagnostics и target/geometry interactions.

title: DR3: Value-Based Deep Reinforcement Learning Requires Explicit Regularization
mechanism: TD implicit regularization и consecutive-feature co-adaptation.
diagnostic: Feature dot products; rank; cosine менее информативен.
limitations: Главная постановка offline RL; отсутствует repair selector.
relevance: Fixed data не исключают вредную bootstrap dynamics.

title: Stop Regressing: Training Value Functions via Classification for Scalable Deep RL
mechanism: Value-loss sensitivity к target noise, scale и nonstationarity.
intervention: MSE, HL-Gauss, two-hot и C51 comparisons.
diagnostic: Growing-target probe, frozen-feature evaluation, noisy-target experiments.
limitations: Head/loss/encoding и hyperparameters могут меняться совместно.
relevance: Основа target/loss arms; categorical switch не чистый target repair.

title: Can Learned Optimization Make Reinforcement Learning Less Difficult?
intervention: Meta-learned continuous updates и actor noise.
diagnostic: Gradients, moments, dormancy, layer/training proportions как inputs.
limitations: Дорогой meta-training; отсутствуют discrete repairs и causal classification.
relevance: Близкий adaptive baseline с OOS environments/architectures.

title: Mitigating Plasticity Loss in Continual Reinforcement Learning by Reducing Churn
mechanism: NTK collapse усиливает churn и gradient correlation.
diagnostic: Out-of-batch output change и empirical NTK.
limitations: Reference-data dependence; continual mitigation, а не checkpoint diagnosis.

title: Preserving Plasticity in Continual Learning via Dynamical Isometry
mechanism: NTK anisotropy и layer-wise Jacobian conditioning.
intervention: AdamO decoupled orthogonality updates; activation/architecture variants.
diagnostic: NTK, weight и Jacobian spectra; dormancy.
limitations: Surrogate assumptions; rectangular B^T B=I alone does not preserve every output-gradient norm; closed ReLU gates limit condition-number argument. No empirical replication.
relevance: Свежая mathematical foundation и combined geometry/optimizer arm.

title: Mastering diverse control tasks through world models
mechanism: Target-scale robustness через symlog и symexp two-hot.
intervention: Loss transforms; Nature Methods также LaProp/adaptive clipping.
diagnostic: Cross-domain robustness; direct repair diagnosis отсутствует.
limitations: ArXiv v2 полный текст и Nature Methods search excerpt; версии различаются.
relevance: Scale/encoding controls; не checkpoint recovery evidence.
